correctness.rationale: For linearized fluctuation dZ=FZ dt+GdB with d<B>_t=Rdt, Itô product gives d E[ZZ^T]/dt=F W+W F^T+G R G^T, hence stationary Lyapunov forcing GRG^T only. The 2026 source Remark 3.8 defines Q_ij=rho_ij sigma_i sigma_j E_i* E_j*, which already is GRG^T since G is negative diagonal. Adding GG^T double-counts every diagonal diffusion variance. With R=I, Q=GG^T, so unique Hurwitz solution W_printed=2W_correct and ellipsoid semiaxes inflate by sqrt(2). Exactly the indicated local covariance error, not a global epidemic-model rejection.
